Economic impact
Economically, the benefits of better work
performance, reduced absenteeism and
improved recruitment and retention
associated with telework were validated by
the study. Two case studies allowed direct
comparisons of productivity between
teleworkers and non-teleworkers and found
an increase among teleworkers in
productivity, along with reduced
absenteeism and increased job satisfaction.
Other factors that contributed to higher work
performance included better quality, higher
output and greater creativity, Telework
increases business resilience, since it allows
work to be done when building operations
are disrupted by factors such as the weather
but the report cautions that it also makes the
organisation more vulnerable to disruption
of information systems (such as intranets),
